insight: Founded in 2009 in Kraków, Poland as Zadane.pl; its AI study helper, Ginny, runs on OpenAI's GPT-4.
name: Brainly
tagline: AI learning companion atop a community homework-help platform.
description: Brainly is a global learning platform where students get homework help backed by a moderated base of community and expert answers. It layers AI on top of that knowledge base — an assistant named Ginny that simplifies, expands, and personalizes answers across school subjects and grades. The free Q&A community is supplemented by a paid Brainly Plus tier.

modelSupport.notes: Ginny AI features are built on OpenAI's GPT-4 over Brainly's answer knowledge base.

edge: One of the largest community Q&A learning platforms, layering AI answers over a moderated base of 250M+ student and expert solutions.

references.title: Brainly Raises $15 Million Series B Beyond Homework Help
Brainly raises $14M after hitting 100 million users
